skills.name: character_body_kinematics
skills.skill: Implement robust kinematic controller movement, jumping, and slope handling using CharacterBody2D and CharacterBody3D with move_and_slide in Godot 4.7.2.
procedure: Instantiate CharacterBody2D/CharacterBody3D with a CollisionShape child resource.
In _physics_process(delta), apply gravity using get_gravity() or project settings to velocity.y when not is_on_floor().
Derive target horizontal velocity from Input vector, applying lerp or move_toward based on acceleration and friction constants.
Call move_and_slide() without arguments (Godot 4 mutates internal velocity property directly).
Query is_on_floor(), is_on_wall(), or get_platform_velocity() post-movement for state resolution.
verification: Run headless test scene with Godot CLI: godot --headless --script test_movement.gd.
Assert velocity decays to 0 on input release without sliding infinitely.
Verify character ascends and descends 45-degree slope meshes without bouncing or falling through floor.
pitfalls: Do not pass velocity into move_and_slide() as was standard in Godot 3.
Avoid applying delta directly to move_and_slide(); velocity is in units/sec and the method accounts for delta internally.
Ensure floor_snap_length is configured when walking down slopes to prevent unwanted airborne states.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Create a CharacterBody3D script in Godot 4.7.2 supporting variable jump height, coyote time, jump buffering, and responsive deceleration on 30-degree slopes.

skills.name: animation_tree_state_machine_orchestration
skills.skill: Configure and control AnimationTree state machines with AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback and blend trees on top of AnimationMixer.
procedure: Attach an AnimationPlayer and AnimationTree to the root node; link anim_player property to the AnimationPlayer path.
Assign tree_root with AnimationNodeStateMachine and populate with states (Idle, Walk, Jump, Attack).
Configure AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition with condition properties or ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO.
Access playback controller in code via: tree.get("parameters/playback") as AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback.
Invoke playback.travel("StateName") or alter blend parameters dynamically via tree.set("parameters/Blend2/blend_amount", value).
verification: Assert active state matches expected animation using playback.get_current_node().
Verify no 'Parameter not found' errors in console during parameter assignment.
Validate transitions complete cleanly using animation_finished signal monitoring in test suite.
pitfalls: AnimationTree active property must be set to true at runtime or during ready.
Path strings in tree.set() are case-sensitive and must match node names inside the blend tree exactly.
Avoid mixing AnimationPlayer.play() with AnimationTree playback; AnimationTree will override manual player calls.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Implement a GDScript component that binds an AnimationTree state machine to a CharacterBody3D, smoothly blending between 8-direction locomotion blend spaces and one-shot jump transitions.

skills.name: grid_pathfinding_astar
skills.skill: Deploy 2D grid pathfinding and dynamic obstacle evasion using AStarGrid2D.
procedure: Instantiate AStarGrid2D and define region via region = Rect2i(start_x, start_y, width, height).
Set cell_size, diagonal_mode (e.g., DIAGONAL_MODE_AT_LEAST_ONE_WALKABLE), and heuristic.
Call astar.update() after setting properties to allocate internal grid arrays.
Iterate over static colliders or TileMapLayer obstacles and invoke set_point_solid(coords, true).
Query paths with get_point_path(from_coords, to_coords) or get_id_path() and convert to world space coordinates.
verification: Ensure get_point_path returns empty array when destination is completely walled off.
Assert path does not cross diagonal barrier corners when diagonal mode restricts corner cutting.
Benchmark execution time for a 1000x1000 grid path search to stay under 5ms.
pitfalls: Calling set_point_solid() or modifying grid parameters without calling update() first will cause crash or no-op.
Feeding world coordinates instead of Vector2i grid coordinates directly to AStarGrid2D methods will return wrong or out-of-bounds nodes.
Forgetting to clear solid points before rebuilding terrain updates will leave phantom blockers.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Write an AStarGrid2D manager that synchronizes walkable cells from a Godot 4.7 TileMapLayer, supports dynamic moving obstacles, and provides smoothed world-coordinate path vectors.

skills.name: polyphonic_audio_pool_routing
skills.skill: Manage high-density, low-latency sound effects using AudioStreamPolyphonic and AudioServer routing.
procedure: Create an AudioStreamPlayer node and assign its stream to an AudioStreamPolyphonic resource.
Set polyphony parameter (maximum concurrent streams) on the AudioStreamPolyphonic resource.
Assign AudioStreamPlayer bus to appropriate audio bus layout (e.g., 'SFX').
In GDScript, acquire stream playback reference via player.get_stream_playback() as AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.
Spawn sounds by calling playback.play_stream(audio_stream, from_offset, volume_db, pitch_scale) and track returned stream IDs for runtime pitch/volume tweaks or early termination.
verification: Play 32 simultaneous audio instances in a loop and verify zero audio dropouts or buffer underrun warnings.
Assert playback.is_stream_playing(id) returns false after clip duration expires.
Verify volume modifications to parent AudioStreamPlayer or AudioServer bus affect polyphonic instances equally.
pitfalls: Attempting to get_stream_playback() before the AudioStreamPlayer is ready and added to the scene tree returns null.
Exceeding the max polyphony count will drop newly played sounds or evict oldest depending on internal voice allocation.
Holding onto stream IDs after streams finish causes stale reference calls if IDs are recycled.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Construct an AudioPool manager class utilizing AudioStreamPolyphonic capable of playing concurrent collision sounds, dynamic pitch shifting, and voice-stealing limits per sound category.

skills.name: compositor_effect_post_processing
skills.skill: Implement custom render-pipeline post-processing shaders using Compositor and CompositorEffect in Godot 4.7.2.
procedure: Create a custom class extending CompositorEffect and export an access flag for render stages (e.g., EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_OPAQUE or POST_PROCESS).
Override _render_callback(p_effect_callback_type, p_render_data) to receive the RenderingData and RenderingDevice instances.
Extract scene render buffers and frame textures via RenderSceneBuffersRD.
Dispatch custom compute shader pipelines or full-screen blit passes using RenderingDevice commands.
Attach the CompositorEffect resource to a Compositor, and assign the Compositor to WorldEnvironment or Camera3D.
verification: Verify effect executes in headless or editor rendering without device loss or RenderingDevice validation layer errors.
Confirm compute uniform sets match active view textures without pipeline stalls.
Toggle compositor active flag and ensure scene cleanly falls back to default visual presentation.
pitfalls: Failing to synchronize read/write hazards using RenderingDevice barriers can cause visual tearing or driver hangs.
Accessing RenderingDevice on incompatible renderer backends (e.g., Compatibility / OpenGL) will fail; CompositorEffect requires Forward+ or Mobile.
Forgetting to handle stereoscopic/multiview rendering passes when VR/XR is active.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Create an autonomous Godot 4.7 CompositorEffect GDScript that applies an outline edge-detection compute shader pass over the scene depth and normal buffer in Forward+ mode.
